name: Mnason (an old disciple from Cyprus)
title: The Hospitable Veteran Disciple
summary: Mnason was a Christian from Cyprus described as an 'old disciple,' indicating that he was among the early believers. He showed hospitality by welcoming Paul and his companions into his home in Jerusalem. His willingness to house Gentile Christians testifies to his open attitude in the early church.

keyEvents.title: Identified as an Old Disciple
keyEvents.description: Mnason is described as an 'old disciple' from Cyprus, suggesting that he was among the first Christians, possibly converted on Pentecost or shortly thereafter.

keyEvents.title: Welcomes Paul in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: During Paul's final journey to Jerusalem, Mnason offered his home as lodging for the apostle and his traveling companions, despite tensions surrounding Paul's ministry among the Gentiles.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Cypriot Christians
keyEvents.description: As a Cypriot, Mnason represented the early spread of the gospel to the island of Cyprus, where Barnabas also came from and where the first missionary journey included preaching.
